pages.title: A Guest from the Ash
pages.text: Connect an ash companion’s taming with its real storage function.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find Pottergeist in the Ash Forest. Native right-click tames it under eligible conditions; then configure following and attach a vase. A click without actual ownership/storage is insufficient.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Pottergeist combines taming, following, storage-vase attachment and decorative variants; it is not an ordinary hostile ghast.
